title: Let the heart open under one clear word
summary: The heart opens when one trusted word is kept, not merely examined. Stay with one clear line until doubt loses room.
takeaway: Stay with one clear line until doubt loses room.
lifeApplication: When the mind starts circling again, write the one instruction you already know and keep it before asking another question.

source.shortMeaning: The heart opens when one trusted word is kept, not merely examined.
source.lifeApplication: Stay with one trusted line until the chest softens around it.
